limitations: Four optimized-debug controls use 2-second warmup plus 8-second sample windows, not full repeated release qualification.
Logical counts exclude non-texture buffers/shaders/queries, allocation alignment, compression, driver-private allocations and physical residency.
Explicit GPU copy counts include harness-issued diagnostic/log copies only. SDK-internal copies/conversions remain unknown.
GPU process usage snapshots are separate and are not summed as physical VRAM. No simultaneous combined peak is inferred.

Shutdown timer covers GPU retirement, owned fixture/observer reporting/reaping and native event-loop/worker completion; excludes final process exit/report serialization/WebView subprocess termination.
